1701.author: Jianyu010
1701.body:
**Found by:** the live-model acceptance run for #1637/#1654 on main `d47d3d6cfc6489f745b2846cd59950de2ce34175`, built on hp-laptop with `tests/eval/hive-live/build_server_env.py --ref d47d3d6cf…` (the `docs/scenarios/hive-behaviour-qa.md` path).

**Defect 1 — package proof refuses main's own registry.** `package proof` fails with `PackageProofError: incoming registry transition suite has an unreviewed shape: history-recovery-sources`. `.github/ci-gates.json` enrols `history-recovery-sources` (path `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests`, added by #1298), but `INCOMING_REGISTRY` / `REVIEWED_PERMANENT_SUITES` in `scripts/ci/server_contract_package.py` pin only `hive-scenarios` as a permanent suite, and the `temp/<feature>/tests` rule rejects this path. Every main since #1298 fails the wheel build for hive-live / `run_hive.py --source wheel`. Fix shape follows #1422: reviewed row in `scripts/ci` first (trusted run reads it from base), then nothing more is needed because the registry row is already on main.

**Defect 2 — runtime venv cannot install `digitalmate-history-context-recovery==0.2.0`.** `tests/scenarios/run_hive.py:prepare_dependencies` pip-installs `bridge_dependencies()`, which now includes that requirement; it is a repo-local package (`temp/history-context-recovery`), not on PyPI or the mirror, so pip fails with `No matching distribution found`. The helper needs to build/install that wheel (as `install_runtime.py` already knows via `RECOVERY_REQUIREMENT`).

**Workaround used (not committed):** allow-list row added in the throwaway source worktree only; wheel built from `temp/history-context-recovery` and installed into the venv by hand. Candidate source files are unchanged.

**Done when:** `build_server_env.py --ref origin/main` completes on a clean host without manual steps.

Refs #1637, #1654. Parent: #1665.
1701.title: [Bug]: hive-live wheel build fails on main: package proof rejects history-recovery-sources and runtime venv lacks the history recovery wheel
